title: H-MERGEROWNFLIP-1 part A, scenarios 2 + 4: (2) the HOST presses Rent (BizManPresentation.RentBuilding) on a building the ledger gives the merged client - refused silently with the log line, no host rent, host money unchanged, the ledger keeps the client; (4) P-LEASEPROBE: the world-ready Harmony patch-owner dump on both machines, and a CLIENT terminate (the BizMan confirm handler) writes enter/exit-or-throw lines and ONE deposit-return stack; afterwards the member's lapsed lease is NOT flipped on the member. PART B: that terminate (whose confirm handler throws, skipping the vacate postfix) is reported to the host BY THE DEPOSIT-RETURN PATH - '[Client] Sent VacateRequest', the host releases, and neither machine's ledger names the client afterwards. Ends dissolved.
preconditions: Reporter fixture fx-hq1 (MERGED pair melaus + Client1; vars.keepMerger). The client's shop is discovered on the host (first flipped key). Dev build with the H-MERGEROWNFLIP-1 levers `ownflip <addr>`, `bizrent <addr>`, `bizterminate <addr>` (they call the BizMan page's own handlers on a bare page object, so every Harmony patch runs; the terminate handler's last line re-enables the page's UI and throws on the bare object AFTER all lease state is written - the throw skips the native method's postfixes, including the vacate report, which reproduces bundle 222227's unreported lease end) plus forrent / rent / mergestatus. H-MERGEROWNFLIP-1 part B deployed (LeaseEndWatch).
